questions.prompt: Which UK rapper features on "Who You Are" from *Yours Truly* (2025)?
questions.explanation: Aitch is on "Who You Are". KR$NA's other UK link, French the Kid (whom he met in London), is on the drill song "10 Pe 10".

questions.prompt: Who produced "Jaanta Kyun" (2019)?
questions.explanation: Deep Kalsi made the beat. He worked with KR$NA again on "Role Model" from *For The Day One$* (2024).

bar: Vardi vaale veer, voh vatan ki vafadari
questions.prompt: KR$NA has explained these lines. Which two subjects does he set side by side?

options.text: Soldiers' loyalty to the nation, and caste discrimination today
Police in uniform, and political corruption

questions.explanation: "Vardi vaale veer" are soldiers in uniform, and "varnbhed" is discrimination by varna (caste). "Vaise" turns praise into criticism. KR$NA said the lines salute the Army and call caste a malaise to uproot.

questions.prompt: On "Asian State of Mind" (2025), KR$NA raps alongside artists from four other Asian countries. Who represents South Korea?
questions.explanation: Jay Park is the Korean voice. The song is Japanese rapper Awich's single (28 Feb 2025), with MaSiWei (China) and VannDa (Cambodia) as the other guests. Awich is also on "Hello" from *Yours Truly*.

questions.prompt: KR$NA's 2023 EP *FAR FROM OVER* has five songs. Which one features AR Paisley?
questions.explanation: "Some Of Us" features AR Paisley. Seedhe Maut are on another song from the same EP, "Hola Amigo".

bar: Gang lage fauj, yahan vardi mein sab
Hand on the heat, pehente garmi mein gloves
questions.prompt: What do "heat" and "garmi" do in the second bar?

options.text: Heat = gun slang; garmi = Hindi for heat
Both mean anger; he stays calm
Heat = hot beat; gloves = DJ gear
Both describe the Tokyo shoot weather

questions.explanation: "Heat" is slang for a gun, so "hand on the heat" means a hand on a gun. "Garmi" is Hindi for heat, so wearing gloves in the garmi (summer) suggests hiding fingerprints. The word "heat" plays across two languages. The first bar sets up the army image: fauj and vardi.

questions.prompt: In September 2020, KR$NA said the IPL 2020 anthem copied one of his earlier songs. Which song?
questions.explanation: He pointed to "Dekh Kaun Aaya Wapas" (first uploaded March 2017); the anthem was "Aayenge Hum Waapas". Its composer, Pranav Ajayrao Malpe, denied copying, and no final outcome was found in the press.

questions.prompt: "Boom Shaka" (28 Apr 2026), KR$NA's song with Haryanvi artist Dhanda Nyoliwala, was produced by which pair?
questions.explanation: Hisab and Phenom produced it. Phenom also made "Vibrate", his song with Badshah on *Yours Truly*.

bar: Peene peh pabandi, Patna meh pakde toh panga
Paaji pehne pagdi, Panjab meh pade panja
questions.prompt: Patna is the capital of Bihar. Which 2016 news from Bihar does the first bar most likely point to?

options.text: Bihar banned the sale and drinking of all liquor
Bihar raised its legal drinking age to 25
Bihar banned drinking only in public places
Bihar cut the tax on liquor

questions.explanation: Bihar banned the sale and drinking of liquor in April 2016. "Peene peh pabandi" means a ban on drinking, so if you get caught in Patna, you are in trouble. The next bar moves to Punjab and stays on P. KR$NA has not explained this line. The reading rests on "peene peh pabandi" and "Patna".

questions.prompt: Which KR$NA collaboration won Best Indie Collaboration at the Radio City Freedom Awards (Season 7, March 2023)?
questions.explanation: Brodha V and KR$NA won for "Forever" (Brodha V's single, Sept 2022). The winners were announced online on 31 March 2023.

questions.lead: In Calm's verse on "Hola Amigo", his crew
bar: ...scan kare QR se pehle jaise L. M. N. O. P.
questions.prompt: Why L, M, N, O, P?

options.text: They come just before Q and R
The order a QR code is read

questions.explanation: In the alphabet, L-M-N-O-P sit right before Q-R. So his boys "scan" you before the QR code can: they are a step ahead. "QR" is both a phone code and two letters.

questions.prompt: KR$NA says that after the first *Sellout* video, his label offered only a 10,000-rupee Facebook ad plan. How was the title-track video paid for?
questions.explanation: He paid for the *Sellout* title-track video out of his own advance. It was an early sign of the do-it-yourself streak in his career.

questions.prompt: After *Sellout* (2014, Universal Music), KR$NA co-founded a small hip-hop label with a friend. What was it called?
questions.explanation: He co-founded Right Now Entertainment with a friend, and it later went dormant. AK Projekts is the company that became Kalamkaar.

questions.lead: In the third verse of "Hola Amigo"
bar: Tere idols ka idol main Jackson Micheal, higher than Eiffel
questions.prompt: What does flipping the name to "Jackson Micheal" do for the bar?

options.text: Turns the name into a Hindi pun
Breaks the rhyme for a pause

questions.explanation: Said "Maikal", the name lands on the same sound as "Eiffel", and the chain runs on through "survival", "recycled" and "cycle". In the usual order, "Jackson" would sit on the rhyme and break it.

questions.prompt: *Yours Truly* (2025) has skits between the songs. Where does their audio come from?

options.text: An old episode of the podcast *VOTP*
Clips from his old TV interviews

questions.explanation: The four "VOTP SKIT" tracks use a 2015 episode of the podcast *VOTP* (*Voice of the People*), in which the hosts, rappers Bobkat and Enkore, talked about his career. The title track also looks back: two letters to himself at three stages of life.

questions.prompt: Clue card. Born in Delhi. Spent about five years in London as a teenager. First rapped as Young Prozpekt, later as Prozpekt. Today he is KR$NA. What is his real name?
questions.explanation: KR$NA is Krishna Kaul. He rapped as Young Prozpekt, then Prozpekt, before he became KR$NA.

questions.prompt: Which KR$NA song is this? It came out on 17 Jan 2024 on Saregama. Its hook comes from a Mukesh classic, and its video was shot in Tokyo, with samurai and yakuza imagery.
questions.explanation: "Joota Japani" turns Mukesh's "Mera Joota Hai Japani" into a rap hook. KR$NA called it "a mix of old and new".

questions.prompt: On 23 Oct 2026, KR$NA released the single "BUZZ" with which act?
questions.explanation: "BUZZ" is a Seedhe Maut and KR$NA single on Mass Appeal, produced by Seedhe Maut's own Calm.

bar: Kaale krtoot krte kameene kamane ko
Kaale dhan ke karan kangaal kiya kitne kisaano ko
questions.prompt: Which device drives these two bars?
questions.explanation: Almost every word starts with "k" (क). The whole song gives each Hindi consonant its own section, like a school lesson.

bar: Hola amigo (Yeah, yeah), kaise ho, theek ho?
questions.prompt: How many languages does it mix?
questions.explanation: Spanish ("hola amigo"), Hindi ("kaise ho, theek ho") and British English slang ("bruv"). That is code-switching for effect. KR$NA said the hook "sounded funny in the moment", so he kept it.

questions.prompt: What is the name of KR$NA's debut album, released in 2014 on Universal Music?
questions.explanation: He made *Sellout* in about two and a half months. His next album, *Still Here*, did not come until 2021.

questions.prompt: Which launch artist features on both "Roll Up" (from *Still Here*, 2021) and "Vibrate" (from *Yours Truly*, 2025)?
questions.explanation: Badshah is on both: "Roll Up" on *Still Here* (2021) and "Vibrate" on *Yours Truly* (2025).

bar: Sar pe aaj topi Gucci, phir bhi dil hai Hindustani
questions.prompt: In the 1955 original, the patloon and the topi came from two countries. Which two did he swap for luxury brands?
questions.explanation: Mukesh sang of an English patloon and a Russian red topi. KR$NA keeps Japan and the Indian heart, swaps the rest for Armani and Gucci, and keeps the "-aani" rhyme.

questions.prompt: KR$NA is a partner in the label Kalamkaar. Which launch artist co-founded Kalamkaar with Ankit Khanna?
questions.explanation: Raftaar and Ankit Khanna founded it. KR$NA joined when it was still called AK Projekts.

questions.prompt: In April 2025, KR$NA announced that his next project would come out on Mass Appeal, the New York label. Which US rapper's label is Mass Appeal?
questions.explanation: Mass Appeal is Nas's label. The news came after Nas's first India show, a Mumbai charity concert on 19 Apr 2025, where KR$NA also performed. *Yours Truly* (22 May 2025) came out on Mass Appeal.

questions.prompt: Who made the beat for "Joota Japani" (2024)?
questions.explanation: Umair, a Pakistani producer, flipped the 1955 original into a drill beat.

bar: Tu kaafi hai, ya bola mera ji (Mera ji)
Kaafi hai, yahan main aur mere G (Mere G)
questions.prompt: What links "mera ji" and "mere G"?

options.text: A simile comparing heart and crew
A slant rhyme with different vowels
A bilingual pun: one sound, two languages

questions.explanation: "Ji" is Hindi (heart, or a term of respect) and "G" is English slang for a close friend. They sound the same, and the ad-libs repeat both to make the pun obvious.

questions.prompt: In 2010, before he was KR$NA, he released "Kaisa Mera Desh" under his early name, Prozpekt. Which scandal did the song take on?
questions.explanation: "Kaisa Mera Desh" was an anti-corruption song about the CWG scam, which shows he wrote political rap long before "Vyanjan".

questions.lead: From the first T section of "Vyanjan" (the hard T)
bar: Taali tehle toli, takra ke tooti taang
T.I taange tedi topi, takla tha 2Pac
questions.prompt: Why do "T.I" and "2Pac" fit into a song built on Hindi consonants?

options.text: Both are guests on the song
Their names start with the same hard T
They're the only English words in it
The letter rule pauses for his influences

questions.explanation: The rule holds by sound, not by script. Said aloud, both English names start with the same hard T as "topi", "takla" and "tedi". "2Pac" even starts with a number. This is "sound over spelling".

questions.prompt: Rolling Stone India called "Hola Amigo" part of a "barter of sorts" between KR$NA and Seedhe Maut. Which song was the other half of the trade, on Seedhe Maut's mixtape *Lunch Break*?
questions.explanation: KR$NA is on Seedhe Maut's "Khatta Flow" (*Lunch Break*, 19 Aug 2023), and Seedhe Maut are on his "Hola Amigo" (*FAR FROM OVER*, 29 Aug 2023). Both came out in August 2023.

questions.prompt: Clue card. A Pakistani rap duo. Each member guests on a different song on KR$NA's 2023 EP *Time Will Tell*, which came out all at once instead of single by single. Who are they?
questions.explanation: Young Stunners are Talha Anjum and Talhah Yunus. Talhah Yunus is on "NGL" and Talha Anjum is on "Been A While".

questions.prompt: "Vyanjan" opens with lines about "kaale dhan" (black money). When did KR$NA say he wrote those opening lines?

options.text: The week after the Nov 2016 demonetisation announcement

questions.explanation: He wrote them before the announcement. They just happened to fit the moment when the video came out.

questions.prompt: In July 2022, KR$NA and Emiway Bantai each released a diss track with the same title (spelled slightly differently). What was it?
questions.explanation: KR$NA's "Machayenge 4" came out on 8 July 2022. Emiway answered with his own "Machayengey 4" a few days later, by 12 July 2022.

bar: Srinagar jaise gehra hai Dal, flow bahta hai jal jaise Zainakadal, beta (Haan)
questions.prompt: What are Dal and Zaina Kadal?

options.text: A lake and a bridge in Srinagar
A lake in Srinagar and a market in Delhi

questions.explanation: Both are in Srinagar: Dal Lake, and Zaina Kadal, one of the city's old bridges over the Jhelum. The line uses "jaise" to compare his flow to the water there.

questions.prompt: Near the end of "Vyanjan", two letters get one word each: "Kshatriya / Trishool". One more one-word section closes the song. Which letter is it?
questions.explanation: Many school charts end the consonants with the joined letters क्ष (ksha), त्र (tra) and ज्ञ (gya), and some add श्र (shra) after them. The song closes on those three: Kshatriya, Trishool, Gyani.
